description: Bus Nouvelle Aquitaine is a dataset listed in data.lotetgaronnenumerique open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by LGNUM. Ce jeu de données contient la liste des arrêts, des horaires et des parcours théoriques des réseaux de transport public des membres du syndicat Nouvelle-Aquitaine Mobilités. Coverage: Lot-et-Garonne. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are Bus, Aquitaine, transport. The portal shows 48,982 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-lotetgaronnenumerique-portal.
